ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.
M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Stimulus image category (alcohol, objects, or non-alcoholic drinks)
Alcohol stimulus reaction time in pull condition
Alcohol stimulus reaction time in push condition
Alcohol stimulus reaction time in pull condition subtracted from alcohol stimulus reaction time in the push condition
Object stimulus reaction time in pull condition
Objects stimulus reaction time in push condition
Objects stimulus reaction time in pull condition subtracted from objects stimulus reaction time in the push condition
Non-Alcoholic beverage stimulus reaction time in pull condition
Non-Alcoholic beverage stimulus reaction time in push condition
Non-Alcoholic beverage stimulus reaction time in pull condition subtracted from Non-Alcoholic beverage stimulus reaction time in the push condition
